install_steps: Download the buildkit release tarball for your platform from https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases — it contains buildctl and buildkitd — and extract to PATH
Verify: buildctl --version (requires a reachable buildkitd for build/prune commands)
note: buildctl talks to a buildkitd daemon (--addr, defaults to the containerd socket or BUILDKIT_HOST). Builds use frontends like dockerfile.v0 and can export to OCI tarballs, registries or local dirs.
